scope: Download targets requested by the exact x64 build job. Includes headers/tools/packaging and is not an inventory of libraries linked into the DLL. Recipe candidates only match literal ExternalProject_Add target names; ambiguous or absent matches remain explicit.
missingDeliverables: Actual per-dependency revisions or immutable archive hashes from this job, including restored cache inputs; identify linked libraries separately from build/download targets.
Full exact dependency sources, submodules, patches and generated configuration needed for the actual DLL build; main mpv/FFmpeg archives alone are insufficient.
Original per-component copyright and license notices tied to the confirmed revisions.
Build environment/toolchain/container identity, commands and configuration for the actual pinned DLL; current recipe and latest image tag alone are insufficient.
Recorded host/runtime distribution compatibility review and an approved source-delivery route tied to exact hashes; no automatic approval.
